# Run 33 tables (generated by `ml_property_dose.py`)

Cells are **leave-one-powder-out Q² (RMSE)**. Q² = 1 − Σ(error²)/Σ(y − ȳ)²: 1 is perfect, 0 is no better than predicting the mean, negative is worse. RMSE is in the target's units. n = 12 powders (11 for the speed exponent).

## Inverse: dosing fingerprint → handbook property

Inputs: log10 mg/rev at 0, 22.5 and 45°, speed exponent, log10 mg per tap at 22.5° and log10 mg in the 15 s hold at 45° (6 features). *Ceiling*: the Q² a perfect model would score if the only error were the handbook spread (each value uniform within its published range).

## Two-part model, the powders that convey, and few-shot prediction

**Two-part model** (logistic P(conveys | AoR), then each class's training mean of log10 mg/rev):

| target | Q² (RMSE) |
|---|---|
| log10 mg/rev, 45 deg | +0.44 (0.77) |
| log10 mg/rev, 22.5 deg | +0.39 (0.88) |
| log10 mg/rev, 0 deg | +0.47 (0.68) |

**Among the 7 powders that convey** (AlSi10Mg, Si (110/200 mesh), Sodium sulfate, Calcium lactate, Barium chloride, Xanthan gum, NaCl (control); SD of log10 mg/rev at 45° = 0.09 decades), one handbook input at a time, leave one out:

| model | Q² (RMSE) |
|---|---|
| mean | -0.36 (0.1) |
| line on angle of repose (deg) | -0.65 (0.11) |
| line on bulk density (g/mL) | -0.55 (0.11) |
| line on tapped density (g/mL) | -0.50 (0.1) |
| line on Hausner ratio | -0.43 (0.1) |
| line on log10 d50 (um) | -0.93 (0.12) |
| line on particle density (g/cm3) | -1.19 (0.13) |
| line on log10 moisture (wt%) | -0.25 (0.095) |
| constant volume x particle density | -1.52 (0.14) |

**Few-shot**: one quick dosing measurement on the held-out powder predicts the rest of its fingerprint (line fitted on the other 11):

| prediction | Q² (RMSE) | 90 % intervals covering |
|---|---|---|
| log10 mg/rev, 45 deg from log10 mg/rev, 22.5 deg | +0.79 (0.47) | 9/12 |
| log10 mg/rev, 0 deg from log10 mg/rev, 22.5 deg | +0.90 (0.3) | 11/12 |
| speed exponent from log10 mg/rev, 22.5 deg | -2.27 (0.45) | 9/11 |
| log10 mg/rev, 45 deg from log10 mg/rev, 0 deg | +0.81 (0.45) | 11/12 |

## Fingerprint replicate noise vs model error

Standard error of log10 mg/rev at 45° from the six protocol C revolutions: median 0.030, max 0.310 decades (12 powders). The best forward model's held-out RMSE is 0.71 decades.
